references.name: Spring Check
references.adopted: Only confirmed server completion may trigger a small check response; separate 44px button targets; cancel animations on owner/route/reduced-motion changes.
references.not_adopted: No React controlled component, motion runtime, Hugeicons dependency, or decorative strike-through copied.

references.name: Swipe Toast
references.adopted: Pause transient timers during focus/hover/hidden tab; persistent error; real async Undo; accessible close; actual mobile navigation and visual viewport clearance.
references.not_adopted: Swipe gesture and upstream fixed 32px bottom placement were not adopted. Undo immediately entered exit state in the demo; disappearance was not independently observed.
demo: Opened actual demo toast and activated Undo.
Read source JavaScript and CSS tabs; checked timer cleanup and aria-live.

references.name: Prompt Bar
references.adopted: Text and Send keep dedicated cells; attachments/emoji/voice in an explicit menu; keyboard Escape restores focus; retained IME/stop/draft recovery safeguards.
references.not_adopted: No decorative canvas, 28px upstream targets, or replacement of existing stream/runtime logic. In the 375px demo, clicking Add unexpectedly showed the effort menu; no claim that upstream mobile hit behavior passed.
